He ordered that an amount equal to his monthly banquet be gathered for it. When it was collected on the seashore, it resembled a great mountain. The whale emerged, swallowed it, and said, "O Solomon, where is the rest of my daily sustenance? This is only a portion of my daily food." Solomon (AS) was astonished and asked, "Is there another creature in the sea like you?" It replied, "There are a thousand nations like me." Solomon (AS) then said, "Glory be to Allah, the Great King."

42.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- عَنْ زَیْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (عَنِ الْحُجُبِ فَقَالَ أَوَّلُ الْحُجُبِ سَبْعَةٌ غِلَظُ کُلِ حِجَابٍ مَسِیرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ بَیْنَ کُلِّ حِجَابَیْنِ مِنْهَا مَسِیرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ وَ الْحِجَابُ الثَّالِثُ سَبْعُونَ حِجَاباً بَیْنَ کُلِّ حِجَابَیْنِ مِنْهَا مَسِیرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ وَ طُولُهُ خَمْسُمِائَةِ عَامٍ حَجَبَةُ کُلِّ حِجَابٍ مِنْهَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَکٍ قُوَّةُ کُلِّ مَلَکٍ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةُ الثَّقَلَیْنِ مِنْهَا ظُلْمَةٌ وَ مِنْهَا نُورٌ وَ مِنْهَا نَارٌ وَ مِنْهَا دُخَانٌ وَ مِنْهَا سَحَابٌ وَ مِنْهَا بَرْقٌ وَ مِنْهَا مَطَرٌ وَ مِنْهَا رَعْدٌ وَ مِنْهَا ضَوْءٌ وَ مِنْهَا رَمْلٌ وَ مِنْهَا جَبَلٌ وَ مِنْهَا عَجَاجٌ وَ مِنْهَا مَاءٌ وَ مِنْهَا أَنْهَارٌ وَ هِیَ حُجُبٌ مُخْتَلِفَةٌ غِلَظُ کُلِّ حِجَابٍ مَسِیرَةُ سَبْعِینَ أَلْفَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقَاتُ الْجَلَالِ وَ هِیَ سَبْعُونَ سُرَادِقاً فِی کُلِّ سُرَادِقٍ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَکٍ بَیْنَ کُلِّ سُرَادِقٍ وَ سُرَادِقٍ مَسِیرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقُ الْعِزِّ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقُ الْکِبْرِیَاءِ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقُ الْعَظَمَةِ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقُ الْقُدْسِ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقُ الْجَبَرُوتِ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقُ الْفَخْر ثُمَّ النُّورُ الْأَبْیَضُ ثُمَّ سُرَادِقُ الْوَحْدَانِیَّةِ وَ هُوَ مَسِیرَةُ سَبْعِینَ أَلْفَ عَامٍ فِی سَبْعِینَ أَلْفَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ الْحِجَابُ الْأَعْلَی وَ انْقَضَی کَلَامُهُ (وَ سَکَتَ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ لَا بَقِیتُ لِیَوْمٍ لَا أَرَاکَ فِیهِ یَا أَبَاالْحَسَنِ (.
42.fa: امام علی (- زیدبن‌وهب گوید: درباره‌ی پرده‌ها از امیرمؤمنان (پرسیدند و ایشان فرمود: «اوّلین پرده‌ها هفت تاست و قطر هریک به‌اندازه‌ی مسیر پانصدسال است و میان هر پرده‌ای پانصدسال فاصله است». پرده‌ی دوّم، هفتاد پرده است که بین هریک، فاصله‌ی پانصدساله است که طول آن پانصد سال است و برای هر پرده‌ای هفتاد هزار فرشته است که قدرت هریک به‌اندازه‌ی قدرت جن و انس است. برخی از این پرده‌ها نور، برخی تاریکی، برخی آتش، برخی دود، برخی ابر، برخی آذرخش، برخی باران، برخی تندر، برخی نور، برخی شن، برخی کوه، برخی گردوغبار، برخی آب و برخی دیگر رودهایند و هریک از این‌ها پرده‌هایی متفاوتند که قطر هر پرده، مسیر هفتاد هزار سال است. آنگاه سرا پرده‌های جلال است که عدد آن به هفتاد می‌رسد که در هر سرا پرده، هفتادهزار فرشته است و فاصله‌ی بین هر سرا پرده، مسیر پانصد سال است. آنگاه سرا پرده‌ی عزّت است، سپس سرا پرده‌ی کبریاء، سپس سرا پرده‌ی عظمت، سپس سرا پرده‌ی قُدس بعد از آن سرا پرده‌ی جبروت و سپس سرا پرده‌ی فخر و بعد از آن نور سپید و تابان و سپس سرا پرده یگانگی و وحدانیّت است که آن مسیر هفتصد هزار سال است و بعد از حجاب اعلی قرار دارد». سخن امام علی (که پایان پذیرفت و ساکت ماند، عمر به ایشان گفت: «ای ابوالحسن (! زنده نباشم روزی که تو را نبینم».
42.en: Zayd ibn Wahb said: The Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS), was asked about the veils (hujub). He replied: "The first veils are seven; the thickness of each veil is a journey of five hundred years, and between each two veils is a journey of five hundred years. The second veil consists of seventy veils; between each two of them is a journey of five hundred years, and its length is five hundred years. Each of these veils is guarded by seventy thousand angels, the strength of each of whom is equal to the strength of the two species (jinn and mankind). Among them are darkness, light, fire, smoke, clouds, lightning, rain, thunder, radiance, sand, mountains, dust, water, and rivers. These are various veils, the thickness of each being a journey of seventy thousand years. Then there are the pavilions (suradiq) of Majesty, which are seventy pavilions; in each pavilion are seventy thousand angels, and between each pavilion and the next is a journey of five hundred years. Then the pavilion of Honor, then the pavilion of Grandeur, then the pavilion of Magnificence, then the pavilion of Holiness, then the pavilion of Omnipotence (Jabarut), then the pavilion of Pride, then the White Light, then the pavilion of Oneness (Wahdaniyyah), which is a journey of seventy thousand by seventy thousand years, and then the Supreme Veil." His speech ended, and he fell silent. Umar said to him: "May I not live to see a day when I do not see you, O Abu al-Hasan."

44.ar: علی بن إبراهیم (- أَ لَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللهَ یُزْجِی سَحاباً أَیْ یُثِیرُهُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ یُؤَلِّفُ بَیْنَهُ فَإِذَا غَلُظَ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رِیحاً فَتُعْصِرُهُ فَیَنْزِلُ مِنْهُ الْمَاءُ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ فَتَرَی الْوَدْقَ یَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلالِهِ أَیْ الْمَطَرَ.
44.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللهَ یُزْجِی سَحَابًا؛ منظور آن است که ابر را از زمین بر می‌انگیزد. ثُمَّ یُؤَلِّفُ بَیْنَهُ؛ یعنی هنگامی‌که غلیظ و متراکم شود، خداوند فرشته‌ای از باد را می‌فرستد تا آن را بچکاند و آب باران از آن فرو ریزد که این همان عبارت: فَتَرَی الْوَدْقَ یَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ است که اشاره به باران دارد».
44.en: "Do you not see that Allah drives clouds" means He stirs them up from the earth, "then He brings them together." When they become thick and dense, Allah sends a wind—an angel of the wind—to squeeze them, and the rainwater descends from them. This is the meaning of His saying: "And you see the rain emerging from within them," referring to the rain.
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 290
44.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 56, p. 373; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 107 (with slight variations in wording); Al-Burhan

44.ar: الصّادق (- فِی کِتَابِ الاهلیلجة قَالَ الصَّادِقِ (فِی کَلَامٍ طَوِیلٍ یذکر فیه: بِهَا الریح یَأْتَلِفُ الْمُفْتَرِقُ وَ بِهَا یَتَفَرَّقُ الْغَمَامُ الْمُطَبِّقُ حَتَّی یَنْبَسِطَ فِی السَّمَاءِ کَیْفَ یَشَاءُ مُدَبِّرُهُ فَ یَجْعَلُهُ کِسَفاً فَتَرَی الْوَدْقَ یَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلالِهِ بِقَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ لِمَعَاشٍ مَفْهُومٍ وَ أَرْزَاقٍ مَقْسُومَةٍ وَ آجَالٍ مَکْتُوبَة.
44.en: In the book al-Ihlilajah, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) said in a lengthy discourse: "By it [the wind], that which is separated is brought together, and by it, the dense clouds are dispersed until they spread across the sky as their Disposer wills. Then He makes them into masses, and you see the rain emerging from their midst in a known measure, for a livelihood that is understood, for sustenance that is apportioned, and for terms that are written."

44.ar: الرّسول (- إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ جَعَلَ السَّحَابَ غَرَابِیلَ لِلْمَطَرِ هِیَ تُذِیبُ الْبَرَدَ حَتَّی یَصِیرَ مَاءً لِکَیْ لَا یُضِرَّ بِهِ شَیْئاً یُصِیبُهُ الَّذِی تَرَوْنَ فِیهِ مِنَ الْبَرَدِ وَ الصَّوَاعِقِ نَقِمَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ یُصِیبُ بِهَا مَنْ یَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِه.
44.fa: پیامبر (- خداوند ابر را اَلَکِ باران گردانید تا تگرگ را ذوب کند و به آب تبدیل شود. برای اینکه اگر به چیزی برخورد کرد به آن آسیب نرساند. بارش‌هایی که به‌صورت تگرگ و صاعقه می‌بینید، عذابی است از سوی خداوند متعال که هرکس را از میان بندگانش بخواهد به آن مبتلا می‌کند.
44.en: Verily, Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) has made the clouds as sieves for the rain; they melt the hail until it becomes water, so that it does not harm anything it strikes. That which you see of hail and lightning is a punishment from Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He), with which He strikes whomsoever He wills among His servants.
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 292
44.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 8, p. 240; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

44.ar: الصّادق (- عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَة عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَالَ: کَانَ عَلِیٌّ (یَقُومُ فِی الْمَطَرِ أَوَّلَ مَا یَمْطُرُ حَتَّی یَبْتَلَّ رَأْسُهُ وَ لِحْیَتُهُ وَ ثِیَابُهُ فَقِیلَ لَهُ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (الْکِنَّ الْکِنَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذَا مَاءٌ قَرِیبُ عَهْدٍ بِالْعَرْشِ ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ یُحَدِّثُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ تَحْتَ الْعَرْشِ بَحْراً فِیهِ مَاءٌ یُنْبِتُ أَرْزَاقَ الْحَیَوَانَاتِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ ذِکْرُهُ أَنْ یُنْبِتَ بِهِ مَا یَشَاءُ لَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنْهُ لَهُمْ أَوْحَی اللَّهُ إِلَیْهِ فَمَطَرَ مَا شَاءَ مِنْ سَمَاءٍ إِلَی سَمَاءٍ حَتَّی یَصِیرَ إِلَی سَمَاءِ الدُّنْیَا فِیمَا أَظُنُ فَیُلْقِیَهُ إِلَی السَّحَابِ وَ السَّحَابُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْغِرْبَالِ ثُمَّ یُوحِی اللَّهُ إِلَی الرِّیحِ أَنِ اطْحَنِیهِ وَ أَذِیبِیهِ ذَوَبَانَ الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ انْطَلِقِی بِهِ إِلَی مَوْضِعِ کَذَا وَ کَذَا فَامْطُرِی عَلَیْهِمْ فَیَکُونَ کَذَا وَ کَذَا عُبَاباً وَ غَیْرَ ذَلِکَ فَتَقْطُرُ عَلَیْهِمْ عَلَی النَّحْوِ الَّذِی یَأْمُرُهَا بِهِ فَلَیْسَ مِنْ قَطْرَةٍ تَقْطُرُ إِلَّا وَ مَعَهَا مَلَکٌ حَتَّی یَضَعَهَا مَوْضِعَهَا وَ لَمْ یَنْزِلْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ قَطْرَةٌ مِنْ مَطَرٍ إِلَّا بِعَدَدٍ مَعْدُودٍ وَ وَزْنٍ مَعْلُومٍ إِلَّا مَا کَانَ مِنْ یَوْمِ الطُّوفَانِ عَلَی عَهْدِ نُوحٍ (فَإِنَّهُ نَزَلَ مَاءٌ مُنْهَمِرٌ بِلَا وَزْنٍ وَ لَا عَدَد.
44.fa: امام صادق (- از امام صادق (روایت است: وقتی آسمان آغاز به بارش می‌کرد، علی (زیر باران می‌رفت، تا سر و ریش و لباسش خیس شود. به ایشان گفتند: «ای امیرمؤمنان (! بر سر خود پوششی بگذار». امام (در جواب می‌فرمود: «این آب تازه از عرش باریده است»، سپس شروع می‌کرد به سخن گفتن و می‌فرمود: «زیر عرش، دریایی از آب است که روزی حیوانات به‌وسیله‌ی آن می‌روید و اگر خدای متعال بخواهد از رحمت خویش برای آن‌ها چیزی روزی دهد، به آن وحی می‌کند و هر آنچه بخواهد باران می‌بارد، از آسمانی به آسمانی دیگر تا اینکه به آسمان دنیا می‌رسد - آن‌گونه که گمان می‌کنم - باران را در ابر که حکمِ اَلَک را دارد می‌ریزد. سپس به باد وحی می‌شود که آن را بکوب و مانند آب ذوب کن. پس آن را به اینجا و آنجا ببر و سپس مدّتی طولانی بر آنان فروریز، پس باران نیز به همان‌گونه که خدا امر فرموده، بر آنان قطره‌قطره می‌بارد و هر قطره‌ای که فرو می‌ریزد، همراه آن فرشته‌ای است که آن قطره را در جای خود قرار می‌دهد و هر قطره بارانی که از آسمان فرو می‌ریزد، شماره‌ی آن مشخص و وزن آن معلوم است، مگر باران طوفان نوح (که در آن آبی فراوان و سیل‌آسا، بی آنکه وزن و شماره‌ی آن مشخص باشد، فرو ریخت».
44.en: Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah narrates from Abu 'Abd Allah (Imam al-Sadiq) (as) who said: "When it first began to rain, Ali (as) would stand in the rain until his head, beard, and clothes became wet. It was said to him, 'O Commander of the Faithful! Seek shelter, seek shelter!' He replied, 'This is water that has recently come from the Throne (al-'Arsh).' He then began to speak, saying: 'Beneath the Throne is a sea of water from which the sustenance of all living creatures grows. When Allah, Mighty is His mention, intends to cause their sustenance to grow for them as a mercy from Him, He reveals to it (the water), and it rains from heaven to heaven until it reaches the lowest heaven—as I believe—where it is cast into the clouds. The clouds act like a sieve. Then Allah reveals to the wind: "Grind it and dissolve it as water dissolves," and then, "Go with it to such-and-such a place and rain upon them." It then pours upon them in such-and-such a volume, as He has commanded it. There is not a single drop that falls except that an angel accompanies it to place it in its designated spot. No drop of rain descends from the sky except by a counted number and a known weight, except for the rain during the Flood in the time of Noah (as), for then the water descended in torrents without weight or measure.'"

44.ar: الرّسول (- لَا تُشِیرُوا إِلَی الْمَطَرِ وَ لَا إِلَی الْهِلَالِ فَإِنَ اللَّهَ یَکْرَهُ ذَلِک.
44.fa: پیامبر (- به باران و هلال ماه اشاره نکنید؛ چرا که خداوند از این کار ناخشنود می‌شود.
44.en: Do not point at the rain nor at the crescent moon, for God dislikes that.
44.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 292

44.ar: الصّادق (- الْبَرَدُ لَا یُؤْکَلُ لِقَوْلِهِ فَیُصِیبُ بِهِ مَنْ یَشاءُ.
44.fa: امام صادق (- تگرگ را نخورید که خداوند فرموده است: فَیُصِیبُ بِهِ مَنْ یَشاءُ.
44.en: Do not eat hail, for God has said: "And He strikes with it whom He wills."
44.refs: Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 17, p. 21; Nur al-Thaqalayn

46.ar: الرّسول (- عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ (قَالَ: کَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِذَا أَرَادَ حَاجَةً أَبْعَدَ فِی الْمَشْیِ فَأَتَی یَوْماً وَادِیاً لِحَاجَةٍ فَنَزَعَ خُفَّهُ وَ قَضَی حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وَ أَرَادَ لُبْسَ خُفِّهِ فَجَاءَ طَائِرٌ أَخْضَرُ فَحَمَلَ الْخُفَّ فَارْتَفَعَ بِهِ ثُمَّ طَرَحَهُ فَخَرَجَ مِنْهُ أَسْوَدُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (هَذِهِ کَرَامَةٌ أَکْرَمَنِیَ اللَّهُ بِهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّی أَعُوذُ بِکَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَنْ یَمْشِی عَلی بَطْنِهِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَنْ یَمْشِی عَلی رِجْلَیْنِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَنْ یَمْشِی عَلی أَرْبَعٍ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ کُلِّ ذِی شَرٍّ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ کُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِناصِیَتِها إِنَّ رَبِّی عَلی صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِیمٍ.
46.en: Ibn Abbas said: Whenever the Messenger of Allah (PBUH) wished to relieve himself, he would walk far away. One day, he went to a valley to relieve himself, took off his khuff (leather sock), and relieved himself. Then he performed wudu and intended to put on his khuff when a green bird came, picked up the khuff, flew up with it, and then dropped it. A black snake came out of it. The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) said: "This is a grace with which Allah has honored me. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of that which walks on its belly, from the evil of that which walks on two legs, from the evil of that which walks on four, from the evil of every possessor of evil, and from the evil of every creature that You have control over its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path." (Hud/56)
46.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 294

46.ar: علی بن إبراهیم (- وَ اللهُ خَلَقَ کُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِنْ ماءٍ أَیْ مِنْ مَنِیٍ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَمْشِی عَلی بَطْنِهِ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَمْشِی عَلی رِجْلَیْنِ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَمْشِی عَلی أَرْبَعٍ یَخْلُقُ اللهُ ما یَشاءُ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیرٌ قَالَ عَلَی رِجْلَیْنِ النَّاسُ وَ عَلَی بَطْنِهِ الْحَیَّاتُ وَ عَلَی أَرْبَعٍ الْبَهَائِمُ وَ قَالَ أَبُوعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَمْشِی عَلَی أَکْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ.
46.fa: علی‌بن‌ابراهیم (- وَ اللهُ خَلَقَ کُلَّ دَابَّةٍ؛ یعنی از آب منی؛ فَمِنْهُم مَّن یَمْشِی عَلَی بَطْنِهِ وَ مِنْهُم مَّن یَمْشِی عَلَی رِجْلَیْنِ وَ مِنْهُم مَّن یَمْشِی عَلَی أَرْبَعٍ یَخْلُقُ اللهُ مَا یَشَاء إِنَّ اللهَ عَلَی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیرٌ؛ آن‌هایی که بر دو پا راه می‌روند، مردم‌اند و آن‌ها که بر شکم راه می‌روند، مارها هستند و آن‌ها که بر چهار پا راه می‌روند، چهارپایان می‌باشند و امام صادق (فرمود: «برخی هم بر بیشتر از چهار پا راه می‌روند».
46.en: "And Allah has created every living creature from water" — that is, from semen. "And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that move on two legs, and of them are those that move on four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent." He said: Those that move on two legs are humans, those that move on their bellies are snakes, and those that move on four are cattle. And Abu Abd Allah (Imam Sadiq) said: "And among them are those that move on more than that."
46.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 294
46.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 61, p. 24; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 107; Nur al-Thaqalayn (with slight variations in wording); Al-Burhan

47.ar: الصّادق (- نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ فِی أَمِیرِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ عُثْمَانَ وَ ذَلِکَ أَنَّهُ کَانَ بَیْنَهُمَا مُنَازَعَةٌ فِی حَدِیقَةٍ فَقَالَ أَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (تَرْضَی بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ لِعُثْمَانَ لَا تُحَاکِمْهُ إِلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَإِنَّهُ یَحْکُمُ لَهُ عَلَیْکَ وَ لَکِنْ حَاکِمْهُ إِلَی ابْنِ شَیْبَةَ الْیَهُودِیِّ فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ لِأَمِیرِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (لَا أَرْضَی إِلَّا بِابْنِ شَیْبَةَ الْیَهُودِیِّ فَقَالَ ابْنُ شَیْبَةَ لِعُثْمَانَ تَأْتَمِنُونَ مُحَمَّداً (عَلَی وَحْیِ السَّمَاءِ وَ تَتَّهِمُونَهُ فِی الْأَحْکَامِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَی رَسُولِهِ (وَ إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ لِیَحْکُمَ بَیْنَهُمْ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ بَلْ أُولئِکَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ.
47.fa: امام صادق (- این آیه درباره‌ی امیرمؤمنان (و عثمان نازل شده است و ماجرا از این قرار است که بین امیرمؤمنان (و عثمان بر سر باغی اختلاف افتاد. امیرمؤمنان (فرمود: «آیا راضی می‌شوی رسول خدا (را به داوری بگیریم»؟ عبدالرّحمن‌بن‌عوف به عثمان گفت: «داوری را نزد رسول خدا (نبرید؛ چرا که او به نفع علی (داوری می‌کند؛ ابن‌شیبه یهودی را به داوری بگیرید». عثمان به امیرمؤمنان (گفت: «من فقط به داوری ابن‌شیبه راضی می‌شوم». ابن شیبه گفت: «آیا شما رسول خدا (را امانتدار وحی می‌دانید درحالی‌که او را در داوری‌کردن متّهم می‌کنید»! پس خدا به پیامبر (چنین وحی کرد: وَ إِذَا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِیَحْکُمَ بَیْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِیقٌ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ، وَإِن یَکُن لهُمُ الحَقُّ یَأْتُوا إِلَیْهِ مُذْعِنِینَ، أَفِی قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ارْتَابُوا أَمْ یَخَافُونَ أَن یَحِیفَ اللهُ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ رَسُولُهُ بَلْ أُوْلَئِکَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ.
47.en: This verse was revealed regarding the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and Uthman. The situation was that there was a dispute between the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and Uthman over a garden. The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said, "Will you agree to take the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) as an arbiter?" Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said to Uthman, "Do not take the case to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), for he will judge in his favor against you. Instead, take it to Ibn Shaybah the Jew for arbitration." Uthman said to the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), "I will only be satisfied with the arbitration of Ibn Shaybah the Jew." Ibn Shaybah said to Uthman, "Do you trust Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) with the revelation of heaven, yet you accuse him regarding judgments?" Then Allah revealed to His Messenger: "And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them..." up to His saying: "...nay, it is they who are the wrongdoers."
47.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 294
47.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 98; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 227; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 107; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

47.ar: ابن عبّاس (- قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی وَ یَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِاللهِ وَ بِالرَّسُولِ وَ أَطَعْنا عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ فِی عَلِیٍ وَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ قُرَیْشٍ ابْتَاعَ مِنْهُ أَرْضاً.
47.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- وَ یَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِاللهِ وَ بِالرَّسُولِ وَ أَطَعْنا ثُمَّ یَتَوَلَّی فَرِیقٌ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِکَ؛ این آیه درباره‌ی امیرالمؤمنین (و مغیرهًْ‌بن‌وایل در باب آن زمینی که امیرالمؤمنین (از او خریده بود، نازل شده است.
47.en: Regarding the words of the Almighty, "And they say, 'We have believed in Allah and the Messenger, and we obey'; then a party of them turns away after that," it was revealed concerning the Commander of the Faithful (Ali) and a man from the Quraysh from whom he had purchased a piece of land.
47.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 296
47.refs: Kashf al-Ghummah, Vol. 1, p. 322 / Kashf al-Yaqin, p. 392

48.ar: ابن عبّاس (- إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ لِیَحْکُمَ بَیْنَهُمْ أَنْ یَقُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَ أَطَعْنَا أَیْ سَمِعْنَا قَوْلَ النَّبِیِّ (وَ أَطَعْنَا أَمْرَهُ وَ إِنْ کَانَ ذَلِکَ فِیمَا یَکْرَهُونَهُ وَ یَضُرُّهُمْ.
48.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ لِیَحْکُمَ بَیْنَهُمْ أَنْ یَقُولُوا سَمِعْنا وَ أَطَعْنا؛ یعنی سخن پیامبر (را شنیدیم و از دستور او اطاعت کردیم، اگرچه دستور پیامبر (در موردی باشد که مؤمنان از آن خوششان نیاید و به ضررشان می‌باشد.
48.en: "And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them, they say, 'We hear and we obey'"—meaning: We heard the words of the Prophet (pbuh) and obeyed his command, even if that command concerned a matter they disliked or which was to their detriment.

51.ar: الباقر (- إِنَّما کانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ إِنَّ الْمَعْنِیَّ بِالْآیَةِ أَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (.
51.fa: امام باقر (- إِنَّما کانَ قَوْلَ المُؤْمِنِینَ إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ؛ منظور آیه امیرالمؤمنین (است.
51.en: "The saying of the believers when they are called to Allah" — the one meant by the verse is the Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib).
51.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 38, p. 234; Al-Manaqib, Vol. 2, p. 10; Nur al-Thaqalayn (with slight variation).

51.ar: الصّادق (- عَن أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (قَالَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ إِنَّما کانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ فِی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (وَ عُثْمَان ... ثمَُّ ذَکَرَ أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (فَقَالَ إِنَّما کانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ لِیَحْکُمَ بَیْنَهُمْ أَنْ یَقُولُوا سَمِعْنا وَ أَطَعْنا إِلَی قَوْلِهِ فَأُولئِکَ هُمُ الْفائِزُون.
51.fa: امام صادق (- از امام صادق (روایت است که فرموده: این آیه: إِنَّما کانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ إِذا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ درباره‌ی امیرالمؤمنین (و عثمان نازل شده است .... سپس خداوند به امیرمؤمنان (اشاره کرده و فرموده است: إِنَّمَا کَانَ قَوْلَ المُؤْمِنِینَ إِذَا دُعُوا إِلَی اللهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ لِیَحْکُمَ بَیْنَهُمْ أَن یَقُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَ أَطَعْنَا وَ أُوْلَئِکَ هُمُ المُفْلِحُونَ، وَ مَن یُطِعِ اللهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ وَ یَخْشَ اللهَ وَ یَتَّقْهِ فَأُوْلَئِکَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ.
51.en: It is narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) that he said: "This verse, 'The saying of the believers, when they are called to Allah...' was revealed regarding the Commander of the Faithful (AS) and Uthman... Then, God mentioned the Commander of the Faithful (AS) and said: 'The saying of the believers, when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them, is only to say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger and fears Allah and is conscious of Him—it is those who are the attainers [of success].'"

52.ar: ابن عبّاس (- نَزَلَتْ فِی عَلِیِّ بْنِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (.
52.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- این آیه درباره‌ی علیّ‌بن‌ابی‌طالب (نازل شده است.
52.en: This verse was revealed regarding Ali ibn Abi Talib.
52.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 296
52.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 35, p. 401; Furat al-Kufi, p. 287; Furat al-Kufi, p. 288; Shawahid al-Tanzil, Vol. 1, p. 535

52.ar: الباقر (- أَعِینُونَا بِالْوَرَعِ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ لَقِیَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنْکُمْ بِالْوَرَعِ کَانَ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَرَجاً إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ یَقُولُ وَ مَنْ یُطِعِ اللهَ وَ رَسُولَهُ فَأُولئِکَ مَعَ الَّذِینَ أَنْعَمَ اللهُ عَلَیْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِیِّینَ وَ الصِّدِّیقِینَ وَ الشُّهَداءِ وَ الصَّالِحِینَ وَ حَسُنَ أُولئِکَ رَفِیقاً فَمِنَّا النَّبِیُّ (وَ مِنَّا الصِّدِّیقُ وَ الشُّهَدَاءُ وَ الصَّالِحُونَ.
52.en: Help us through piety (wara'), for whoever among you meets Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, with piety, it shall be a relief for him before Allah. Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says: "And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger, then they are with those upon whom Allah has bestowed favor—of the prophets, the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs, and the righteous. And excellent are those as companions." The Prophet is from us, and the steadfast affirmer of truth is from us, and the martyrs and the righteous are also from us.

53.ar: الصّادق (- عَن عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ قَالَ: ذَکَرْنَا خُرُوجَ الْقَائِمِ (عِنْدَ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (فَقُلْتُ کَیْفَ لَنَا أَنْ نَعْلَمَ ذَلِکَ قَالَ یُصْبِحُ أَحَدُکُمْ وَ تَحْتَ رَأْسِهِ صَحِیفَةٌ عَلَیْهَا مَکْتُوبٌ طاعَةٌ مَعْرُوفَةٌ.
53.fa: امام صادق (- عبدالله‌بن‌عجلان گوید: در خدمت امام صادق (درباره‌ی قیام قائم (سخن به میان آوردیم؛ من عرض کردم: «چگونه ما می‌توانیم از آمدن او اطّلاع حاصل کنیم»؟ فرمود: «صبح که یکی از شما از خواب برمی‌خیزد کاغذی را در زیر سر خود می‌یابد که در آن نوشته است: طاعَةٌ مَعْرُوفَةٌ؛ یعنی پیروی از قائم (کار معروف و خوبی است».
53.en: Abdullah ibn Ajlan said: We were discussing the uprising of the Qa'im (AS) in the presence of Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq) (AS). I asked, "How will we know that?" He replied, "One of you will wake up in the morning to find a scroll under his head upon which is written: 'Ta'ah ma'rufah' (a known obedience)."
53.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 52, p. 305; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 52, p. 324; Nur al-Thaqalayn

54.ar: الصّادق (- لَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَیْکُمْ أَنْفُسَکُمْ قَالَ النَّبِیُّ (أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ عَلَیْکُمْ أَنْفُسَکُمْ لا یَضُرُّکُمْ مَنْ ضَلَّ إِذَا اهْتَدَیْتُمْ وَ عَلِیٌّ (نَفْسِی وَ أَخِی أَطِیعُوا عَلِیّاً (فَإِنَّهُ مُطَهَّرٌ مَعْصُومٌ لَا یَضِلُّ وَ لَا یَشْقَی ثُمَّ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآیَةَ قُلْ أَطِیعُوا اللهَ وَ أَطِیعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّما عَلَیْهِ ما حُمِّلَ وَ عَلَیْکُمْ ما حُمِّلْتُمْ وَ إِنْ تُطِیعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ الْمُبِین.
54.fa: امام صادق (- وقتی خداوند عزّوجلّ این فقره از آیه را نازل فرمود: عَلَیْکُمْ أَنْفُسَکُم پیامبر اکرم (فرمود: «ای مردم مراقب نفس خود باشید، وقتی هدایت شدید گمراه‌شدن دیگران ضرری به شما نمی‌رساند و علی (نفس و برادر من است؛ او را اطاعت کنید زیرا مطهّر و معصوم بوده؛ نه ضلالت به او رسد و نه شقاوت، سپس این آیه را قرائت فرمود: قُلْ أَطِیعُوا اللهَ وَ أَطِیعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّما عَلَیْهِ ما حُمِّلَ وَ عَلَیْکُمْ ما حُمِّلْتُمْ وَ إِنْ تُطِیعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ المُبِینُ».
54.en: When Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed [the verse], "Take care of your own selves" (alaykum anfusakum), the Prophet (PBUH) said: "O people, take care of your own selves; if you are guided, the misguidance of others will not harm you. And Ali is my self (nafs) and my brother; obey Ali, for he is purified and infallible (ma'sum); he neither goes astray nor is he wretched." Then he recited this verse: "Say, 'Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away, then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the clear notification.'"
54.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 38, p. 82; 'Ilal al-Sharayi', Vol. 1, p. 175; Ma'ani al-Akhbar, p. 352

54.via: Imam al-Sadiq (as) narrating from Abu al-Hasan Musa (as) from his father (as)
54.ar: الصّادق (- عَن أَبِی الْحَسَنِ مُوسَی عَنْ أَبِیهِ (فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قُلْ أَطِیعُوا اللهَ وَ أَطِیعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّما عَلَیْهِ ما حُمِّلَ مِنَ السَّمْعِ وَ الطَّاعَةِ وَ الْأَمَانَةِ وَ الصَّبْرِ وَ عَلَیْکُمْ ما حُمِّلْتُمْ مِنَ الْعُهُودِ الَّتِی أَخَذَهَا اللَّهُ عَلَیْکُمْ فِی عَلِیٍّ (وَ مَا بَیَّنَ لَکُمْ فِی الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ فَرْضِ طَاعَتِهِ فَقَوْلُهُ وَ إِنْ تُطِیعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا أَیْ وَ إِنْ تُطِیعُوا عَلِیّاً (تَهْتَدُوا وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ هَکَذَا نَزَلَت.
54.fa: امام صادق (- امام کاظم (از پدرش (نقل کرده که درباره‌ی آیه: قُلْ أَطِیعُوا اللهَ وَ أَطِیعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّوا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَیْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ فرموده است: «آنچه پیامبر (به آن تکلیف شده، شنیدن، طاعت، امانتداری و صبر است». و درباره‌ی: وَ عَلَیْکُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ فرموده است: «آنچه بر عهده‌ی شماست، پیمان‌هایی اس-ت که خداوند متعال در مورد امام علی (از شما گرفته و آنچه در قرآن برایتان تبیین نموده، لزوم فرمانبرداری از اوست. و منظور از وَ إِن تُطِیعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا این است که اگر از علی (پیروی کنید، راه خواهید یافت و وَ مَا عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ المُبِینُ.
54.en: Regarding the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "Say, 'Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged: hearing, obedience, trustworthiness, and patience; and upon you is that with which you have been charged: the covenants that Allah has taken from you regarding Ali (as), and what He has clarified for you in the Quran regarding the obligation of obeying him. So His saying: 'And if you obey him, you will be guided' means: if you obey Ali (as), you will be guided. 'And there is not upon the Messenger except the clear notification.'" That is how it was revealed.
54.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 23, p. 303; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 364; al-Burhan.

54.ar: علی بن إبراهیم (- قَولُهُ قُلْ أَطِیعُوا اللهَ وَ أَطِیعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّما عَلَیْهِ ما حُمِّلَ قَالَ مَا حُمِّلَ النَّبِیِّ (مِنَ النُّبُوَّةِ وَ عَلَیْکُمْ ما حُمِّلْتُمْ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ.
54.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- قُلْ أَطِیعُوا اللهَ وَ أَطِیعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّوا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَیْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ؛ آنچه برعهده‌ی نبی اکرم (است نبوّت می‌باشد و آنچه بر دوش شماست، طاعت و فرمانبرداری می‌باشد.
54.en: Regarding His saying, "Say, 'Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away, then upon him is only that which he has been burdened with,'" he said: "That which the Prophet has been burdened with is the Prophethood, and that which you have been burdened with is obedience and compliance."
54.refs: Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 107; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

54.ar: الرّسول (- یَا مَعَاشِرَ قُرَّاءِ الْقُرْآنِ اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِیمَا حَمَّلَکُمْ مِنْ کِتَابِهِ فَإِنِّی مَسْئُولٌ وَ إِنَّکُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ إِنِّی مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ تَبْلِیغِ الرِّسَالَةِ وَ أَمَّا أَنْتُمْ فَتُسْأَلُونَ عَمَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ مِنْ کِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَ سُنَّتِی.
54.fa: پیامبر (- ای گروه‌های قاریان قرآن، از خداوند عزّوجل از آنچه از کتابش برعهده‌ی شما نهاد، پروا داشته باشید، چراکه هم من و هم شما مسئولید، من از رساندن رسالت [الهی] مسئولم و امّا شما، از آنچه از قرآن و سنّت من که [عهده‌دارش] شدید، پرسیده خواهید شد.
54.en: O groups of Quran reciters, fear Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, regarding what He has entrusted you with from His Book, for I am accountable and you are accountable. I am accountable for conveying the Message, and as for you, you will be questioned regarding what you have been entrusted with from the Book of Allah and my Sunnah.

54.ar: الصّادق (- فَبَلَّغَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (مَا أُرْسِلَ بِهِ وَ صَدَعَ بِمَا أُمِرَ وَ أَدَّی مَا حُمِّلَ مِنْ أَثْقَالِ النُّبُوَّة.
54.fa: امام صادق (- و پیامبر (بار سنگین نبوّت که برعهده‌اش نهاده شده بود را به کامل‌ترین شکل، به منزل رسانید.
54.en: The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) conveyed that with which he was sent, proclaimed that which he was commanded, and fulfilled the heavy burdens of prophethood that were placed upon him.

54.ar: الصّادق (- عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ کَثِیرٍ التَّمِیمِیُّ الْیَمَانِیُّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ حَرْبٍ الْهِلَالِیَّ أَمِیرَ الْمَدِینَةِ یَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (فَقُلْتُ لَهُ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فِی نَفْسِی مَسْأَلَةٌ أُرِیدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَکَ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَخْبَرْتُکَ بِمَسْأَلَتِکَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِی وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَسَلْ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (وَ بِأَیِ شَیْءٍ تَعْرِفُ مَا فِی نَفْسِی قَبْلَ سُؤَالِی عَنْهُ قَالَ بِالتَّوَسُّمِ وَ التَّفَرُّسِ أَ مَا سَمِعْتَ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِنَّ فِی ذلِکَ لَآیاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِینَ وَ قَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (اتَّقُوا فِرَاسَةَ الْمُؤْمِنِ فَإِنَّهُ یَنْظُرُ بِنُورِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ فَأَخْبِرْنِی بِمَسْأَلَتِی قَالَ أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِی عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (لِمَ لَمْ یُطِقْ حَمْلَهُ عَلِیٌّ (عِنْدَ حَطِّهِ الْأَصْنَامَ مِنْ سَطْحِ الْکَعْبَةِ مَعَ قُوَّتِهِ وَ شِدَّتِهِ وَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهُ فِی قَلْعِ بَابِ الْقَمُوصِ بِخَیْبَرَ وَ الرَّمْیِ بِهَا وَرَاءَهُ أَرْبَعِینَ ذِرَاعاً وَ کَانَ لَا یُطِیقُ حَمْلَهُ أَرْبَعُونَ رَجُلًا وَ قَدْ کَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (یَرْکَبُ النَّاقَةَ وَ الْفَرَسَ وَ الْبَغْلَةَ وَ الْحِمَارَ وَ رَکِبَ الْبُرَاقَ لَیْلَةَ الْمِعْرَاجِ وَ کُلُّ ذَلِکَ دُونَ عَلِیٍّ (فِی الْقُوَّةِ وَ الشِدَّةِ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَه عَنْ هَذَا وَ اللَّهِ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَکَ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَأَخْبِرْنِی فَقَالَ إِنَّ عَلِیّاً (بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ (شُرِّفَ وَ بِهِ ارْتَفَعَ وَ بِهِ وَصَلَ إِلَی إِطْفَاءِ نَارِ الشِّرْکِ وَ إِبْطَالِ کُلِّ مَعْبُودٍ دُونَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لَوْ عَلَا النَّبِیُّ (لِحَطِّ الْأَصْنَامِ لَکَانَ بِعَلِیٍّ (مُرْتَفِعاً وَ شَرِیفاً وَ وَاصِلًا إِلَی حَطِّ الْأَصْنَامِ وَ لَوْ کَانَ ذَلِکَ کَذَلِکَ لَکَانَ أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ أَ لَا تَرَی أَنَّ عَلِیّاً (قَالَ لَمَّا عَلَوْتُ ظَهْرَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (شُرِّفْتُ وَ ارْتَفَعْتُ حَتَّی لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَنَالَ السَّمَاءَ لَنِلْتُهَا أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الْمِصْبَاحَ هُوَ الَّذِی یُهْتَدَی بِهِ فِی الظُّلْمَةِ وَ انْبِعَاثُ فَرْعِهِ مِنَ أَصْلِهِ وَ قَدْ قَالَ عَلِیٌّ (أَنَا مِنْ أَحْمَدَ کَالضَّوْءِ مِنَ الضَّوْءِ أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً وَ عَلِیّاً (کَانَا نُوراً بَیْنَ یَدَیِ اللَّهِ جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ قَبْلَ خَلْقِ الْخَلْقِ بِأَلْفَیْ عَامٍ وَ إِنَّ الْمَلَائِکَةَ لَمَّا رَأَتْ ذَلِکَ النُّورَ رَأَتْ لَهُ أَصْلًا قَدِ انْشَعَبَ فِیهِ شُعَاعٌ لَامِعٌ فَقَالَتْ إِلَهَنَا وَ سَیِّدَنَا مَا هَذَا النُّورُ فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَیْهِمْ هَذَا نُورٌ مِنْ نُورِی أَصْلُهُ نُبُوَّةٌ وَ فَرْعُهُ إِمَامَةٌ أَمَّا النُّبُوَّةُ فَلِمُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِی وَ رَسُولِی وَ أَمَّا الْإِمَامَةُ فَلِعَلِیٍّ حُجَّتِی وَ وَلِیِّی وَ لَوْلَاهُمَا مَا خَلَقْتُ خَلْقِی أَ مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (رَفَعَ یَدَیْ عَلِیٍّ (بِغَدِیرِ خُمٍّ حَتَّی نَظَرَ النَّاسُ إِلَی بَیَاضِ إِبْطَیْهِمَا فَجَعَلَهُ مَوْلَی الْمُسْلِمِینَ وَ إِمَامَهُمْ وَ قَدِ احْتَمَلَ (الْحَسَنَ وَ الْحُسَیْنَ (یَوْمَ حَظِیرَةِ بَنِی النَّجَّارِ فَلَمَّا قَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ نَاوِلْنِی أَحَدَهُمَا یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (قَالَ نِعْمَ الْحَامِلَانِ وَ نِعْمَ الرَّاکِبَانِ وَ أَبُوهُمَا خَیْرٌ مِنْهُمَا وَ رُوِیَ فِی خَبَرٍ آخَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (حَمَلَ الْحَسَنَ وَ حَمَلَ جَبْرَئِیلُ الْحُسَیْنَ فَلِهَذَا قَالَ نِعْمَ الْحَامِلَانِ وَ إِنَّهُ (کَانَ یُصَلِّی بِأَصْحَابِهِ فَأَطَالَ سَجْدَةً مِنْ سَجَدَاتِهِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قِیلَ لَهُ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (لَقَدْ أَطَلْتَ هَذِهِ السَّجْدَةَ فَقَالَ (نَعَمْ إِنَّ ابْنِی ارْتَحَلَنِی فَکَرِهْتُ أَنْ أُعَجِّلَهُ حَتَّی یَنْزِلَ وَ إِنَّمَا أَرَادَ (بِذَلِکَ رَفْعَهُمْ وَ تَشْرِیفَهُمْ- فَالنَّبِیُّ (رَسُولُ بَنِی آدَمَ وَ عَلِیٌّ (إِمَامٌ لَیْسَ بِنَبِیٍّ وَ لَا رَسُولٍ فَهُوَ غَیْرُ مُطِیقٍ لِحَمْلِ أَثْقَالِ النُّبُوَّةِ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ الْهِلَالِیُّ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ زِدْنِی یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ إِنَّکَ لَأَهْلٌ لِلزِّیَادَةِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (حَمَلَ عَلِیّاً عَلَی ظَهْرِهِ یُرِیدُ بِذَلِکَ أَنَّهُ أَبُووُلْدِهِ وَ إِمَامُ الْأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ صُلْبِهِ کَمَا حَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ فِی صَلَاةِ الِاسْتِسْقَاءِ وَ أَرَادَ أَنْ یُعْلِمَ أَصْحَابَهُ بِذَلِکَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ تَحَوَّلَ الْجَدْبُ خَصْباً قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ زِدْنِی یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (فَقَالَ احْتَمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (عَلِیّاً (یُرِیدُ بِذَلِکَ أَنْ یُعْلِمَ قَوْمَهُ أَنَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِی یُخَفِّفُ عَنْ ظَهْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (مَا عَلَیْهِ مِنَ الدَّیْنِ وَ الْعِدَاتِ وَ الْأَدَاءِ عَنْهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ یَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (زِدْنِی فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ احْتَمَلَهُ لِیُعْلِمَ بِذَلِکَ أَنَّهُ قَدِ احْتَمَلَهُ وَ مَا حَمَلَ لِأَنَّهُ مَعْصُومٌ لَا یَحْتَمِلُ وِزْراً فَتَکُونُ أَفْعَالُهُ عِنْدَ النَّاسِ حِکْمَةً وَ صَوَاباً وَ قَدْ قَالَ النَّبِیُّ (لِعَلِیٍّ (یَا عَلِیُّ (إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی حَمَّلَنِی ذُنُوبَ شِیعَتِکَ ثُمَّ غَفَرَهَا لِی وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ - لِیَغْفِرَ لَکَ اللهُ ما تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِکَ وَ ما تَأَخَّرَ وَ لَمَّا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی عَلَیْهِ- یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا عَلَیْکُمْ أَنْفُسَکُمْ قَالَ النَّبِیُّ (یَا أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ عَلَیْکُمْ أَنْفُسَکُمْ لا یَضُرُّکُمْ مَنْ ضَلَّ إِذَا اهْتَدَیْتُمْ وَ عَلِیٌّ نَفْسِی وَ أَخِی أَطِیعُوا عَلِیّاً فَإِنَّهُ مُطَهَّرٌ مَعْصُومٌ فَلا یَضِلُّ وَ لا یَشْقی ثُمَّ تَلَا هَ-ذِهِ الْآیَةَ - قُلْ أَطِیعُوا اللهَ وَ أَطِی-عُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّما عَلَیْهِ ما حُمِّلَ وَ عَلَیْکُ-مْ ما حُمِّلْتُمْ وَ إِنْ تُطِیعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ الْمُبِینُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ الْهِلَالِیُّ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِی جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ (أَیُّهَا الْأَمِیرُ لَوْ أَخْبَرْتُکَ بِمَا فِی حَمْلِ النَّبِیِّ (عَلِیّاً (عِنْدَ حَطِّ الْأَصْنَامِ مِنْ سَطْحِ الْکَعْبَةِ مِنَ الْمَعَانِی الَّتِی أَرَادَهَا بِهِ لَقُلْتَ إِنَّ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ لَمَجْنُونٌ فَحَسْبُکَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ مَا قَدْ سَمِعْتَهُ فَقُمْتُ إِلَیْهِ وَ قَبَّلْتُ رَأْسَهُ وَ قُلْتُ اللهُ أَعْلَمُ حَیْثُ یَجْعَلُ رِسالَتَهُ.
54.en: Jabbar ibn Kathir al-Tamimi al-Yamani said: I heard Muhammad ibn Harb al-Hilali, the governor of Medina, say: I asked Ja’far ibn Muhammad (AS) and said to him, "O son of the Messenger of Allah, there is a question in my mind that I wish to ask you." He replied, "If you wish, I will inform you of your question before you ask me, and if you wish, you may ask." I said, "O son of the Messenger of Allah, by what means do you know what is in my mind before I ask you about it?" He said, "By intuition and discernment (tawassum and farasa). Have you not heard the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Indeed, in that are signs for those who discern' (15:75), and the saying of the Messenger of Allah (SAWA): 'Beware of the discernment of the believer, for he looks with the light of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic'?" I said, "O son of the Messenger of Allah, inform me of my question." He said, "You wanted to ask me why the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) did not carry Ali (AS) when he was casting down the idols from the roof of the Kaaba, despite Ali’s strength and intensity, and what was manifested by him in uprooting the gate of Qamus at Khaybar and throwing it behind him for forty cubits, when forty men could not carry it? And [you wanted to ask] why the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) would ride the camel, the horse, the mule, and the donkey, and rode the Buraq on the night of the Mi'raj, while all of these were less than Ali (AS) in strength and intensity." I said, "By Allah, this is what I wanted to ask you, O son of the Messenger of Allah, so inform me." He said, "Ali (AS) was honored by the Messenger of Allah (SAWA), and through him he was elevated, and through him he reached the extinguishing of the fire of polytheism and the invalidation of every object of worship other than Allah, the Almighty and Majestic. If the Prophet (SAWA) had been elevated by Ali (AS) to cast down the idols, he would have been elevated and honored by Ali (AS) and would have reached the casting down of the idols through him; and if that were the case, he would have been superior to him. Do you not see that Ali (AS) said: 'When I climbed onto the back of the Messenger of Allah (SAWA), I was honored and elevated, to the point that if I had wished to reach the sky, I would have reached it.' Do you not know that the lamp is that by which one is guided in the darkness, and the emergence of its branch is from its root? Ali (AS) said: 'I am from Ahmad like light from light.' Do you not know that Muhammad and Ali (AS) were a light before Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, two thousand years before the creation of the creatures? And when the angels saw that light, they saw an origin in which a shining ray had branched out, so they said: 'Our God and our Master, what is this light?' Then Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed to them: 'This is a light from My light; its origin is Prophethood and its branch is Imamate. As for Prophethood, it is for Muhammad, My servant and My Messenger; and as for Imamate, it is for Ali, My proof and My vicegerent. And were it not for them, I would not have created My creation.' Do you not know that the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) raised the hands of Ali (AS) at Ghadir Khumm until the people saw the whiteness of their armpits, and he made him the master of the Muslims and their Imam? He carried Hasan and Husayn (AS) on the day of the enclosure of Banu Najjar, and when one of his companions said to him, 'Hand me one of them, O Messenger of Allah,' he said, 'Excellent are the carriers and excellent are the riders, and their father is better than them.' It is narrated in another report that the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) carried Hasan, and Gabriel carried Husayn, and that is why he said, 'Excellent are the carriers.' And he (SAWA) was praying with his companions and prolonged one of his prostrations. When he finished, it was said to him, 'O Messenger of Allah, you prolonged this prostration.' He said, 'Yes, my son had climbed upon me, and I disliked to hasten him until he descended.' He (SAWA) intended by that their elevation and honor. The Prophet (SAWA) is the Messenger of the children of Adam, and Ali (AS) is an Imam, not a Prophet nor a Messenger, so he was not capable of bearing the burdens of Prophethood." Muhammad ibn Harb al-Hilali said: I said to him, "Give me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah." He said, "You are indeed worthy of more. The Messenger of Allah (SAWA) carried Ali (AS) on his back, intending by that [to show] that he is the father of his children and the Imam of the Imams from his loins, just as he turned his cloak in the prayer for rain (istisqa), intending to inform his companions by that that the drought had turned into fertility." I said to him, "Give me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah." He said, "The Messenger of Allah (SAWA) carried Ali (AS), intending by that to inform his people that he is the one who will lighten the burden from the back of the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) regarding what is upon him of debt, promises, and fulfillment on his behalf after him." I said to him, "O son of the Messenger of Allah, give me more." He said, "He carried him to inform them by that that he carried him, and he did not carry [him] because he is infallible and does not bear a burden, so his actions are, in the eyes of the people, wisdom and correctness. The Prophet (SAWA) said to Ali (AS): 'O Ali, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has placed the sins of your Shia upon me, then He forgave them for me.' That is the saying of the Almighty and Majestic: 'That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow' (48:2). And when Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, revealed to him: 'O you who have believed, upon you is [responsibility for] yourselves' (5:105), the Prophet (SAWA) said: 'O people, upon you is yourselves; he who has gone astray will not harm you if you have been guided. And Ali is myself and my brother; obey Ali, for he is purified and infallible, so he does not go astray and is not wretched.' Then he recited this verse: 'Say, Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is that which he is burdened with, and upon you is that which you are burdened with. And if you obey him, you will be guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the clear notification' (24:54)." Muhammad ibn Harb al-Hilali said: Then Ja’far ibn Muhammad (AS) said to me, "O Amir, if I were to inform you of the meanings intended by the Messenger of Allah (SAWA) in carrying Ali (AS) when casting down the idols from the roof of the Kaaba, you would say that Ja’far ibn Muhammad is mad. So let what you have heard be sufficient for you." I stood up to him, kissed his head, and said, "Allah knows best where He places His message" (6:124).

54.ar: أمیرالمؤمنین (- لَمَّا أَظْهَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (بِمَکَّةَ دَعْوَتَهُ وَ أَبَانَ عَنِ اللَّهِ مُرَادَهُ رَمَتْهُ الْعَرَبُ عَنْ قِسِیِّ عَدَاوَتِهَا بِضُرُوبِ إِمْکَانِهِمْ ... فَجَاءَهُ قَوْمٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِکِینَ فَقَالُوا لَهُ یَا مُحَمَّدُ (تَزْعُمُ أَنَّکَ رَسُولُ (رَبِّ الْعَالَمِینَ ثُمَّ أَنَّکَ لَا تَرْضَی بِذَلِکَ حَتَّی تَزْعُمُ أَنَّکَ سَیِّدُهُمْ وَ أَفْضَلُهُمْ فَإِنْ کُنْتَ نَبِیّاً فَأْتِنَا بِآیَةٍ کَمَا تَذْکُرُهُ عَنِ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (قَبْلَکَ مِثَالَ نُوحٍ (الَّذِی جَاءَ بِالْغَرَقِ وَ نَجَا فِی سَفِینَتِهِ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (الَّذِی ذَکَرْتَ أَنَّ النَّارَ جُعِلَتْ عَلَیْهِ بَرْداً وَ سَلَاماً وَ مُوسَی (الَّذِی زَعَمْتَ أَنَّ الْجَبَلَ رُفِعَ فَوْقَ رُءُوسِ أَصْحَابِهِ حَتَّی انْقَادُوا لِمَا دَعَاهُمْ إِلَیْهِ صَاغِرِینَ دَاخِرِینَ وَ عِیسَی (الَّذِی کَانَ یُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا یَأْکُلُونَ وَ مَا یَدَّخِرُونَ فِی بُیُوتِهِمْ وَ صَارَ هَؤُلَاءِ الْمُشْرِکُونَ فِرَقاً أَرْبَعَ هَذِهِ تَقُولُ أَظْهِرْ لَنَا آیَةَ نُوحٍ (وَ هَذِهِ تَقُولُ أَظْهِرْ لَنَا آیَةَ مُوسَی (وَ هَذِهِ تَقُولُ أَظْهِرْ لَنَا آیَةَ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (وَ هَذِهِ تَقُولُ أَظْهِرْ لَنَا آیَةَ عِیسَی (فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (إِنَّما أَنَا نَذِیرٌ مُبِینٌ آتَیْتُکُمْ {أَتَیْتُکُمْ} بِآیَةٍ مُبَیِّنَةٍ هَذَا الْقُرْآنِ الَّذِی تَعْجِزُونَ أَنْتُمْ وَ الْأُمَمُ وَ سَائِرُ الْعَرَبِ عَنْ مُعَارَضَتِهِ وَ هُوَ بِلُغَتِکُمْ فَهُوَ حَجَّةُ اللَّهِ وَ حَجَّةُ نَبِیِّهِ عَلَیْکُمْ وَ مَا بَعْدَ ذَلِکَ فَلَیْسَ لِیَ الِاقْتِرَاحُ عَلَی رَبِّی وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ الْمُبِینُ إِلَی الْمُقِرِّینَ بِحُجَّةِ صِدْقِهِ وَ آیَةِ حَقِّهِ وَ لَیْسَ عَلَیْهِ أَنْ یَقْتَرِحَ بَعْدَ قِیَامِ الْحُجَّةِ عَلَی رَبِّهِ مَا یَقْتَرِحُهُ عَلَیْهِ الْمُقْتَرِحُونَ الَّذِینَ لَا یَعْلَمُونَ هَلِ الصَّلَاحُ أَوِ الْفَسَادُ فِیمَا یَقْتَرِحُونَ.
54.en: When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) made his call public in Mecca and clarified the will of God, the Arabs attacked him with the bows of their enmity, using every means at their disposal... A group of polytheists came to him and said, "O Muhammad! You claim that you are the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds, and you are not satisfied with that, but you also claim that you are their master and the best of them. If you are a prophet, bring us a sign as you mention regarding the prophets before you—like Noah, who brought the flood and was saved in his ark with the believers; and Abraham, who you mentioned had the fire made cool and peaceful for him; and Moses, who you claimed had the mountain raised above the heads of his followers until they submitted to what he called them to in a state of humility and subjection; and Jesus, who used to inform them of what they ate and what they stored in their houses." These polytheists split into four groups: one said, "Show us the sign of Noah," another said, "Show us the sign of Moses," another said, "Show us the sign of Abraham," and another said, "Show us the sign of Jesus." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) replied, "I am only a clear warner. I have brought you a clear sign: this Quran, which you, the nations, and all the Arabs are unable to challenge, even though it is in your own language. Therefore, it is the proof of God and the proof of His Messenger against you. Beyond that, it is not for me to make demands of my Lord, and 'the duty of the Messenger is only to convey the message clearly' (Ankabut/50) to those who acknowledge the evidence of his truthfulness and the sign of his legitimacy. It is not for him, after the proof has been established, to demand from his Lord what those who make demands—who do not know whether there is benefit or corruption in what they demand—are asking for."
54.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 10, p. 304

54.via: The Prophet (SAWA) - narrated from Imam Baqir (AS)
54.ar: الرّسول (- عَن أبی جَعفَر (خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللهِ (فِی الیَومِ الغَدِیرِ فَقَالَ (... مَعَاشِرَ النَّاسِ إِنَّ إِبْلِیسَ أَخْرَجَ آدَمَ (مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ بِالْحَسَدِ فَلَا تَحْسُدُوهُ فَتَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُکُمْ وَ تَزِلَّ أَقْدَامُکُمْ فَإِنَّ آدَمَ (أُهْبِطَ إِلَی الْأَرْضِ بِخَطِ-یئَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَ هُوَ صَفْوَةُ اللَّهِ عَ-زَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ کَی-ْفَ بِکُمْ وَ أَنْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَ مِنْکُمْ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّهِ أَلَا إِنَّهُ لَا یُبْغِضُ عَلِیّاً (إِلَّا شَقِیٌّ وَ لَا یَتَوَالَی عَلِیّاً (إِلَّا تَقِیٌّ وَ لَا یُؤْمِنُ بِهِ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنٌ مُخْلِصٌ فِی عَلِیٍّ (وَ اللَّهِ نَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ الْعَصْرِ؛ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ، وَ الْعَصْر ... مَعَاشِرَ النَّاسِ قَدْ أَشْهَدْتُ اللَّهَ وَ بَلَّغَتْکُمْ رِسَالَتِی وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ الْمُبِینُ.
54.en: The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) delivered a sermon on the day of Ghadir, saying: "O people! Indeed, Iblis expelled Adam (AS) from Paradise through envy, so do not envy him, lest your deeds be rendered void and your feet slip. For Adam (AS) was cast down to the earth for a single error, even though he was the chosen one of Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He). How will it be for you, given who you are, and among you are the enemies of Allah? Beware! No one hates Ali (AS) except a wretched one, and no one loves Ali (AS) except a pious one, and no one believes in him except a sincere believer. By Allah, the Surah of al-Asr was revealed regarding Ali (AS): 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. By the time...' O people! I have called Allah as a witness and I have conveyed His message to you, and the Messenger is not responsible for anything but clear conveyance."
54.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 37, p. 210; Al-Tahsin by Ibn Tawus, p. 585; (with slight variations in wording)

54.ar: الرّسول (- أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ لَا تَسُبُّوا عَلِیّاً (وَ لَا تَحْسُدُوهُ فَإِنَّهُ وَلِیُّ کُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَ مُؤْمِنَةٍ بَعْدِی فَأَحِبُّوهُ بِحُبِّی إیّاهُ وَ أَکْرِمُوهُ لِکَرَامَتِی وَ أَطِیعُوهُ للهِ وَ لِرَسُولِهِ وَ اسْتَرْشِدُوهُ تَوَفَّقُوا وَ تَرْشُدُوا فَإِنَّهُ الدَّلِیلُ لَکُمْ عَلَی اللَّهِ بَعْدِی فَقَدْ بَیَّنْتُ لَکُمْ أَمْرَ عَلِیٍّ فَاعْقِلُوهُ وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ الْمُبِینُ.
54.fa: پیامبر (- ای مردم! به علی (دشنام ندهید و نسبت به او حسادت نورزید چرا که علی (بعد از من، سرپرست [و امامِ] هر مرد و زن با ایمان است؛ پس او را به خاطر اینکه من او را دوست می‌دارم دوست بدارید و به خاطر اینکه من او را گرامی می‌دارم گرامی بدارید، أَطِیعُوهُ لِلهِ وَ لِرَسُولِهِ و به خاطر خدا و رسولش از او پیروی کرده و از او راهنمایی بخواهید تا کامیاب شده و هدایت یابید؛ چرا که او بعد از من، راهنمای شما به‌سوی خداوند است. من آنچه مربوط به علی (است را برای شما بیان کردم، پس در آنچه گفتم بیاندیشید؛ وَ ما عَلَی الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلاغُ المُبِینُ.
54.en: O people! Do not insult Ali, and do not envy him, for he is the guardian [and Imam] of every believing man and woman after me. So love him because I love him, and honor him because I honor him. Obey him for the sake of Allah and His Messenger, and seek his guidance so that you may succeed and be guided, for he is your guide to Allah after me. I have clarified to you the matter of Ali, so reflect upon it; "And the Messenger has no duty but the clear conveyance [of the message]."
